title: Lindsey Vonn Gets Worked by Celeb Trainer Gunnar Peterson
description:
I am no stranger to a hard workout, but celebrity trainer Gunnar Peterson has been pushing me to my limits. Gunner is famous for giving Khloe Kardashian her revenge body and also trains some of my friends like Kate Beckinsale, PK, Ciara, and lots of NBA players. He is no joke and I definitely was sore for a week after this!

Love, Lindsey
author: Lindsey Vonn
